title: 9 Things a Godly Man Builds at 22 That His Wife Will Feel at 32
caption:
Marriage is mostly decided years before the ring. These nine get built in private, at 22, while nobody is clapping.

Save this, then pick the one you've been putting off.

Which one is weakest right now?

theme: He chases God, not a wife.
